name: Three-Valued Logic Safe Anti-Join (Eliminating the NOT IN NULL Trap)
description: Marketing queries to find active customers who have not churned often use `WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM churned_users)`. If a single `NULL` exists in `churned_users`, SQL three-valued logic causes the entire query to return ZERO rows.
prompt:
Marketing queries to find active customers who have not churned often use `WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM churned_users)`. If a single `NULL` exists in `churned_users`, SQL three-valued logic causes the entire query to return ZERO rows.

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: customer_id, name.
Results should be ordered as specified.
golden_sql:
-- Robust anti-join that is immune to NULL records in the subquery
            SELECT 
                c.customer_id,
                c.name
            FROM all_customers c
            WHERE NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 
                FROM churned_customers ch 
                WHERE ch.customer_id = c.customer_id
            )
            ORDER BY c.customer_id;
why_it_fails: In SQL, `val NOT IN (1, NULL)` evaluates to `UNKNOWN`, which evaluates to `FALSE` in WHERE clauses, silently discarding every single record.
